description: Create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' containing manual steps for the developer to regenerate and update the API key. Then create a PR with the code changes from FEAT-001 and enable auto-merge if the build passes.
steps: Create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent'. The issue body should contain the exact markdown content specified in the task requirements with the manual steps.
Create a new git branch (e.g., fix/api-key-expired-handling), commit the changes from FEAT-001, and push to remote.
Create a pull request targeting main with a clear title and description explaining the changes.
Run npm run build to verify the build passes. If it passes, enable auto-merge on the PR. If it fails, add a comment 'Auto-merge blocked: build failed' instead.
acceptance_criteria: A GitHub issue exists titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with 'urgent' label and the specified body content
A PR exists with the error handling changes from FEAT-001
The PR has auto-merge enabled (if build passes) or a comment explaining why not (if build fails)
